stem_en: Given below are two statements: Statements I : In a scrubber the exhaust from the thermal plant is passed through the electric wires to charge the dust particles. Statement II : Particulate matter (PM 2.5) cannot be removed by scrubber but can be removed by an electrostatic precipitator. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

statements.label: I
statements.text: In a scrubber the exhaust from the thermal plant is passed through the electric wires to charge the dust particles.

statements.label: II
statements.text: Particulate matter (PM 2.5) cannot be removed by scrubber but can be removed by an electrostatic precipitator.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct

b6_reason: Charging dust particles by passing exhaust through electrode wires is the electrostatic precipitator, not a scrubber (a scrubber removes gases such as SO2 by a water or lime spray), so Statement I is wrong while Statement II is right.
